scope: Base armour, class default strike/defense/power only; equipment ignored.

prompts.fullCapeAttack: Edit this production sprite sheet, preserving the six existing sword poses, armor, closed steel helmet, straight sword held in the anatomical RIGHT hand, rear three-quarter view facing right, pose positions, body scale and camera. The ONLY design correction is Reaver's CAPE: replace ALL shredded ribbon-like cloth with a FULL CRIMSON CAPE. It must be one broad, substantial, continuous piece of heavy dark-crimson cloth attached across both shoulders, covering the entire back down to near the ankles, with natural large folds and one continuous lower hem. No holes through the cape, no split streamers, no strips of red fabric, no exposed back armor through gaps in the cape. A little worn texture at the continuous hem is fine; do not make it tattered. Let the broad cape billow with each attack while retaining the exact same garment in every cell. Keep visible sword arm and boots clear, no added shield, no extra limbs, no second sword. EXACTLY SIX separate full-body figures in 3 columns x 2 rows: ready, windup, advance, contact, follow-through, return. Keep each entire figure, cape and sword inside its own equal cell with generous transparent gutters. At least 25 pixels clear padding at all outside edges including helmets and sword tips. Preserve realistic painted dark fantasy detail and weathered steel base plate. Output a 1536x1024 sprite sheet with genuinely transparent background, no tinted backdrop, no ground shadow, no effects, no aura, no labels or lines.
prompts.reaverDefense: Production 2D painted game sprite sheet, EXACTLY THREE complete figures in one horizontal row of three equal square cells. Genuine transparent background. Keep each entire figure, weapon tip, boots and cape within its own cell with 12 percent clear padding. Same rear three-quarter camera facing right, same armor and proportions in all three frames. No effects, glow, aura, ground shadows, scenery, text, borders, or extra limbs. Use the Reaver in the supplied full-cape reference: closed steel helmet, weathered steel base plate, FULL broad continuous crimson cape from both shoulders to ankles, NO shredded strips or holes. Create DEFENSE frames: 1 lift the straight sword diagonally in front of the torso into guard; 2 brace knees and hold firm against a blow, sword across the right-front side; 3 relax guard and lower the sword to return. Sword is in the anatomical RIGHT hand in every frame; left hand remains empty and may brace near the chest. NO shield. Preserve the full continuous cape and its large natural folds.
